subject: SOC 2 Type II kickoff — evidence checklist, bridge-letter options & micro-templates
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@bluewave.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@bluewave.com
Date: 2025-09-12T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and evidence transfer options

Hi Mateo,

We're kicking off our vendor security review for Q4 and need the following from Redwood to complete BlueWave's procurement checklist: 1) SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), 2) a bridge letter if the report's audit period doesn't cover Nov 1, 2024 - Oct 31, 2025, and 3) a short list of minimally required artifacts (logs, retention policies, sample config screenshots) we can request if needed.

Can you also confirm secure transfer options (SFTP, pre-signed links, or a controlled SharePoint) and whether Redwood can provide a short one-page manifest of what's included in the report (what systems/services and subservice org coverage)?

We have a tight deadline — procurement would like materials by 2025-09-19 if possible.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Senior Security PM
BlueWave Logistics
elena.rossi@bluewave.com

Attachment: BlueWave_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf (reference)

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@bluewave.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-09-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and evidence transfer options

Elena — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to help and can meet the 9/19 window. Quick notes and what we'll provide as a starting package: 

- Primary deliverable: Redacted SOC 2 Type II report for the most recent audit period. If the window doesn't match your requested timeframe, we'll provide a signed bridge letter.
- Minimal artifacts we typically share (high level):
  * System inventory and scope summary (what services are in-scope)
  * Data retention policy excerpts and S3 lifecycle screenshots where relevant
  * Sample access-control role mapping and a short list of log examples (auth/infra/ops) — redacted samples only
  * Evidence manifest (what's in the bundle + drive paths)
- Secure transfer options: SFTP to an account you control, pre-signed S3 objects with 7-day expiry, or SharePoint/Box with folder-level access. We can do encrypted zip by request.
- Bridge-letter approach: two options — 1) brief attestation (one page) covering the gap, or 2) an extended bridge (2 pages) that explains compensating controls. I'll attach a one-page template and a scope PDF.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Scope.pdf, BridgeLetter_Template.docx

Micro-templates (below) you can paste into procurement threads — feel free to use them: 

1) Short ask (procurement-friendly): 
"Redwood has provided a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a one-page bridge letter outlining audit coverage. Secure delivery via SFTP will be shared once access is confirmed"

2) Minimal acceptance reply (one line):
"Received SOC 2 Type II and bridge letter; materials satisfy initial evidence request — procurement to confirm final clearance."

If useful I'll assemble the bundle tomorrow and share a secure transfer link and manifest.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
+1-415-555-0192

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@bluewave.com>, mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-09-13T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and evidence transfer options

Elena — quick follow from our side with a couple clarifications to speed procurement: 

- Audit period: our latest Type II covers 2024-10-01 through 2025-03-31. That does not fully cover your requested range (2024-11-01 - 2025-10-31). We'll include the bridge letter template Mateo attached that explains the gap and lists compensating controls (log retention, continuous monitoring, disaster recovery cadence).
- Evidence: for an initial pass we recommend you request the items marked as "Tier 1" below — those are usually sufficient for procurement sign-off:
  * Redacted SOC 2 Type II (report + auditor opinion)
  * System scope summary (diagram + in-scope services)
  * Data retention policy excerpt (S3 and DB)
  * Sample auth log (redacted, 7–14 days) and an example of automated alerting rule (screenshot)
- Transfer: we prefer pre-signed S3 links with 7-day expiry for large bundles; we can also set up an SFTP account on request. For DocuSign/acknowledgements, we have a standard Envelope template.

If you confirm which artifacts you need now (Tier 1 only, or Tier 1 + Tier 2), we'll stage the bundle and share a manifest (CSV) with the secure links and approximate sizes.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Sr. Compliance Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@bluewave.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@bluewave.com, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-09-16T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and evidence transfer options

Thanks team — that timeline works. Please proceed with Tier 1 bundle and include the one-page bridge letter (option 1). For transfer, pre-signed S3 links are fine. Procurement will confirm access after we review the manifest.

Two quick asks before you upload:
1) Can you include a single-line description next to each artifact in the manifest (e.g., "auth_log_redacted.log — contains 7 days of auth events, PII redacted")?
2) Please send the DocuSign link for the bridge letter (we prefer e-sign for audit trails).

Elena
Elena Rossi
Senior Security PM, BlueWave Logistics
